claims.content: Allows users to set protection over managed archives and ensure in a way, that no unauthorized user will have access to them.

goal.raw_text: Allows users to set protection over managed archives and ensure in a way, that no unauthorized user will have access to them.

claims.content: User
User selects 'Create keyfile' from Tools menu or clicks 'Create keyfile' button

trigger.raw_text: User selects 'Create keyfile' from Tools menu or clicks 'Create keyfile' button

claims.content: User accesses the Tools menu in PeaZip file manager interface.
User selects 'Create keyfile' from the Tools submenu.
System displays the 'Create keyfile' dialog window with entropy sampling tools and password generation options.
User may optionally load a file to sample entropy for keyfile generation using the 'Load file' button.
User may click 'Suggest password' to generate a random password.
User clicks 'Create keyfile' button to generate the keyfile (and optionally set password).
System generates the keyfile and/or sets the password as specified by the user.
User may set password and optionally keyfile during archive creation process by pressing the icon with the lock on it.
User may select an archive to be updated that needs to be 'locked' from file manager interface, press the button writing 'Tools' on it and selecting 'Enter password/keyfile' from the submenu.
User may select the archive to be updated that needs to be 'locked' from file manager interface and press the icon with the lock on it, which appears on the status-bar (bottom right corner).
A keyfile has been generated and is available for use in protecting archives.
The user may have optionally set a password alongside the keyfile for archive protection.
The generated keyfile and/or password can be applied to lock an archive during creation or update process.
